([[Boca Raton, Florida]]) | college = [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]] (2021–2022) | highlights = * [[American Athletic Conference|AAC]] All-Freshman Team (2022) }} '''Joshua Minott''' (born November 25, 2002) is an American-Jamaican [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis Tigers]]. ==High school career== Minott played basketball for [[Saint Andrew's School (Boca Raton, Florida)|Saint Andrew's School]] in [[Boca Raton, Florida]]. In his junior season, he averaged 17.2 points, 7.4 rebounds and 3.3 assists per game, helping his team win the Class 3A state championship, its first state title.{{cite web |last1=Nelsen |first1=Chris |title=HS boys basketball preview: St. Andrew's looks to go back-to-back; Forest Hill eyes state return; Wellington regroups |url=https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/sports/high-school/basketball/2020/12/02/josh-minott-looks-lead-st-andrews-another-fhsaa-state-title/3795642001/ |website=[[The Palm Beach Post]] |access-date=June 14, 2022 |date=December 2, 2020}} As a senior, Minott averaged 23.1 points and 8.3 rebounds per game, and was named [[Palm Beach County, Florida|Palm Beach County]] Class 5A-1A Player of the Year by the ''[[Sun-Sentinel]]''.{{cite web |last1=Lichtenstein |first1=Adam |title=Palm Beach 5A-1A boys basketball player of the year: Joshua Minott, St. Andrew’s senior |url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/sports/highschool/all-county/fl-sp-ss-prem-ac-pb-bhoop-small-poy-20210328-tqfinuojendjhiype6grxv4nmy-story.html |website=[[Sun-Sentinel]] |access-date=June 14, 2022 |date=March 27, 2021}} A four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], he committed to playing college basketball for [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]] over offers from Florida State, Texas, Baylor and Maryland.{{cite web |last1=Munz |first1=Jason |title=4-star prospect Josh Minott commits to Memphis |url=https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/college/memphis-tigers/basketball/2020/08/08/memphis-basketball-josh-minott-penny-hardaway-recruiting-cody-toppert/5571709002/ |website=[[The Commercial Appeal]] |access-date=June 14, 2022 |date=August 8, 2020}} ==College career== On January 23, 2022, Minott recorded a career-high 18 points and nine rebounds in an 83–81 win over [[Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball|Tulsa]].{{cite web |last1=Munz |first1=Jason |title=Memphis basketball rallies from 15-point deficit to beat Tulsa: Our top takeaways |url=https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/college/memphis-tigers/basketball/2022/01/23/memphis-basketball-tyler-harris-josh-minott-lead-tigers-win-tulsa/9063897002/ |website=[[The Commercial Appeal]] |access-date=June 14, 2022 |date=January 23, 2022}} As a freshman at Memphis, he averaged 6.6 points and 3.8 rebounds in 14.6 minutes per game. Minott was named to the [[American Athletic Conference]] (AAC) All-Freshman Team and was a three-time AAC Freshman of the Week. On March 24, he declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]].{{cite web |last1=Smarr |first1=Emilee |title=Former St. Andrew's star Josh Minott declares for 2022 NBA draft |url=https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/sports/high-school/basketball/2022/03/24/josh-minott-former-st-andrews-star-declares-2022-nba-draft/7154292001/ |website=[[The Palm Beach Post]] |access-date=June 14, 2022 |date=March 24, 2022}} He opted to remain in the draft, forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{cite web |last1=Taylor |first1=Cody |title=Report: Memphis freshman Josh Minott to stay in NBA draft |url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2022/05/27/memphis-josh-minott-nba-draft-agent/ |publisher=The Rookie Wire |access-date=June 14, 2022 |date=May 27, 2022}} ==National team career== Minott was born in [[Florida]] but plays for the Jamaican national team.{{cite web |last1=Wheeler |first1=Daniel |title=Josh Minott focuses on NBA dream |url=https://jamaica-gleaner.com/article/sports/20220327/josh-minott-focuses-nba-dream |website=[[The Gleaner]] |access-date=June 14, 2022 |date=March 27, 2022}} At the 2019 [[Centrobasket]] Under-17 Championship in Puerto Rico, he averaged 26 points, nine rebounds and 4.6 steals per game.{{cite web |title=Joshua Minott (JAM)'s profile – Centrobasket U17 Championship 2019 |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/u17centrobasket/2019/player/Joshua-Minott |publisher=[[FIBA]] |access-date=June 14, 2022}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://gotigersgo.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/josh-minott/9887 Memphis Tigers bio] [[Category:2002 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Jamaican men's basketball players]] [[Category:Jamaican expatriate basketball people in the United States]] [[Category:Memphis Tigers men's basketball players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Basketball players from Florida]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Boca Raton, Florida]]
